newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps-Jet fuel surges on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps-Jet fuel surges on tight supply.

text.p: Singapore jet fuel swaps firmed late on Thursday on talks of tightening regional supplies and renewed winter buying interest from North Asia, traders said.

The December jet fuel/gas oil spread (regrade) rose sharply and was last quoted at $1.45/$1.70 against Wednesday's bid at $1.25 a barrel. January regrade also rose and was quoted at $1.80/$2.00 from a day earlier's $1.40/$1.70, brokers said.
They said that the market was also boosted by Wednesday's physical trade in Singapore for a 100,000-barrel cargo at $31.75 per barrel free-on-board (fob), a new post winter high.
The deal was $1.25 a barrel over physical gas oil trades also concluded on Wednesday.
Two 150,000-barrel cargoes traded late Wednesday at $30.50 a barrel fob Singapore.
These gas oil trades and expected large purchases from India and China had kept swap prices firm despite a large overnight fall to crude prices. Crude futures prices had rebounded since then.
China is expected to buy about 600,000-tonnes of gas oil for December, up 100,000-tonnes from October due to lower crude runs and reduced import tariffs.
Indian Janaury gas oil purchases are talked in the market at a hefty 700,000-tonnes, up from the 520,000-tonnes that was awarded in December.
December gas oil was last quoted at $30.30/$30.40 unchanged from this morning.
December gas oil swaps traded this morning at $30.10, $30.15 and $30.20 a barrel, brokers said. January traded at $29.65, $29.70 and $29.81 earlier in the day.
Traders said that the strong regional buying more than compensated for the 84-cent drop in January Brent crude on Wednesday.
Fuel oil swaps remained firmed late afternoon with December swaps quoted at $119.25/$120.50 per tonne, brokers said.
The marked edged up on expectations of new buying from China following a nine percent cut in import tariffs to three percent, trader said.
Naphtha was quoted lower on the weaker overnight crude values in very thin trade, with December swaps quoted at $22.60/$22.85, down from Wednesday's $22.90/$23.10, a broker said.
